fact: The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records that Guinea-Bissau signed the Malabo Convention on 2015-01-31 and had not ratified it.

The Data Protection Africa factsheet headlines that Guinea-Bissau has no data protection law and that its data protection authority is not appointed; it gives no date for the finding beyond its published date, 2022-05-25, used here.

Guinea-Bissau's national UPR report says the National People's Assembly's inaction blocks key legislation, and that several bills, including one on personal data protection, are awaiting discussion; no date is given, so the document's published date of 18 February 2025 is used.
A professor at the Bissau Faculty of Law, speaking at an ECOWAS Court conference in Dakar on 22 September 2026, said Guinea-Bissau does not yet have specific data protection legislation.

The speaker said a bill provides for creating a 'Data Protection Agency', with independence risks in its membership and in leaving its organisation to a decree; the article gives no stage for the bill.

fact: The same speaker said Guinea-Bissau has no dedicated national data protection authority, these matters being handled by several institutions sector by sector.
